layoutPrinciples: Airy soft-white canvas with pastel lavender, mint, and butter spotlight cards above a rounded planning workspace.
Friendly geometric hierarchy paired with calm educational callouts and accessible purple data visualizations.
Zero manipulative gamification, zero confetti, strictly credible tabular financial outputs.

componentStyling.accent: Primary purple (#793FDC) with white text (6.5:1 AA+) and deep purple ink (#241343) on pastel surfaces (>11:1 AAA)

imageryGuidance: Editorial matte ceramic architectural stepping-block financial illustration in matching lavender, mint, butter, and deep violet tones.
accessibilityNotes: Deep purple ink (#241343) on soft white (#FCFBFF), lavender (#F1ECFC), mint (#B9EAD9), and butter (#FFF0BE) consistently exceeds 10:1 WCAG AAA contrast. Primary purple buttons (#793FDC) with pure white text achieve 6.5:1 WCAG AA contrast.
